cues: These elements share a set of properties.
They are hard, dense metals with high melting points, because their unpaired d electrons join in metallic bonding.
They show variable oxidation states, coloured ions and paramagnetism.
They form complexes and alloys, trap small atoms in interstitial compounds, and they are excellent catalysts.
